scope: S5 reference preparation only: no physics stepping, no training, no change to the frozen body or to any acceptance threshold
problem: The frozen 9-landmark retarget asks our 7-DOF leg to hit five distal tarsus landmarks that this body does not have. Measured error is p50 .053, p95 .154, max .385, and the material point sits on a mesh vertex that cannot reproduce tarsal geometry, so the targets are partly unreachable by construction.

change.targets_kept: coxa anchor, femur centre, tibia centre (three positions that this body can actually realise)
change.targets_dropped: tarsus1, tarsus2, tarsus3, tarsus4, claw_origin, material_foot as separate position targets
change.target_added: one direction target: the measured distal chain direction, u_fold = normalise(official material_foot - official tarsus1), compared against our own ankle-to-material-point direction
change.rationale: the distal chain cannot be represented by joints this body lacks, so only its direction is meaningful; folding it into a direction term replaces six unreachable position goals with one reachable direction goal
change.weight_note: direction weight raised from 0.05 to 0.2 because it now carries the whole distal chain instead of one of four direction terms
change.solver: identical to the frozen round: per-leg least_squares TRF with analytic Jacobian, bounds = compiled ranges intersected with previous +-0.06 rad, max_nfev 80 first / 16 later
change.adhesion: NOT folded into joint angles: the official 6 adhesion actuators are attachment forces, not kinematics, and this body has no such actuator. Adding a force channel would be a body modification and is explicitly out of scope here; it is listed as the separate next candidate (B2).

acceptance_of_this_step.primary: achieved OLD-metric error (the frozen 9-landmark normalised error, computed on the same solutions) must be lower than the frozen solver's .0532 median / .385 max
acceptance_of_this_step.secondary: direction error distribution must be reported; in-limit fraction and solver terminations must be reported
acceptance_of_this_step.no_threshold_relaxation: the comparison uses the frozen metric unchanged; the new objective only changes what is optimised, never what is measured

data.official_landmarks: regenerated with the frozen landmark definitions in the isolated teacher environment
